system.description:
You refine your chakra flow, to allow for elemental kneading and casting, simultaneously. You gain the following benefits:

When you take elemental damage from a hostile effect, of a damage type that matches a nature affinity you have, you can spend your Reaction, gaining resistance to the triggering damage.

When you would take elemental damage, you can spend your reaction, or if you used this stances reaction to gain resistance, as part of that reaction, make a Chakra Control Check vs creature who damaged you Ninjutsu save DC. On a success, until the end of your next turn, attack and damage rolls made with your Combat scroll are made with advantage.

While concentrating on two or more Ninjutsu with a nature release keyword, you reduce each cost to maintain concentration by 1.

Evocation Technique – Elemental Discharge. While wielding a Combat Scroll, when you cast a jutsu with a nature release keyword, you can make a Combat Scroll attack against one creature other than one affected by the triggering jutsu, as part of the same action.
system.requirement: Have a Ninjutsu with a nature release keyword on your known list.
